data.name: Aguste
data.gender_notes: Aguste is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word augere, meaning 'to increase'. The name Aguste was borne by several early Christian saints, including St. Augustine of Hippo, a renowned philosopher and theologian whose writings greatly influenced Western Christianity. The name signifies one who is majestic, revered, and venerable. The name Aguste carries the meaning “Majestic, venerable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aguste usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, venerable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires respect and reverence.
data.etymology: Aguste belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, venerable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aguste total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Although not commonly used as a given name today, the name Aguste retains a sense of majesty and respect in cultural contexts.
